safetyMessage: Use only tweaks marked working or tested for your ROM. Recheck LSPosed scopes and reboot after a system update.
changelog: Renamed helper app to ColorOS Toolbox.
Added a lightweight toolbox launcher with clear tweak toggles.
Added safe scope refresh guidance for broken tweaks after ROM updates.
Added basic update checking and changelog display from public release metadata.
Added Malayalam localization scaffold for the main toolbox screen.
